title.en: A cowork workstation on a Paseo-derived daemon (work in progress)
title.zh: 建在 Paseo 衍生 daemon 上的協作工作站（開發中）

description.en: Work in progress: the Better Agent Terminal desktop UI on a daemon derived from Paseo, with task rules inside the daemon. Not an official Paseo or BAT build, and not a release.
description.zh: 開發中：把 Better Agent Terminal 的桌面介面接到衍生自 Paseo 的 daemon，任務規則放在 daemon 裡。不是 Paseo 或 BAT 的官方版本，也不是正式發行版。

eyebrow.en: Work in progress · BAT UI on a Paseo daemon
eyebrow.zh: 開發中 · 跑在 Paseo daemon 上的 BAT 介面

headline.en: Everyone sees the run. One client drives.
headline.zh: 人人看得到，一人說了算。

lede.en: BAT Cowork puts the Better Agent Terminal desktop UI on a daemon derived from Paseo and keeps the task rules inside that daemon. It is early: one of seven work packages is accepted, nothing is released, and it must not touch a production daemon.
lede.zh: BAT Cowork 把 Better Agent Terminal 的桌面介面接到衍生自 Paseo 的 daemon，任務規則也放在這個 daemon 裡。目前還很早期：七個工作包只通過一個，沒有任何正式版本，也不能接到正式環境的 daemon。

notes.zh: 非 Paseo 或 BAT 官方版本

meta.en: No signing key · no staging host
meta.zh: 沒有簽章金鑰 · 不連 staging 主機

label.en: Paseo write messages behind the send gate

title.en: One agent, several clients, nobody in charge.
title.zh: 客戶端一多，就沒人主導。

body.en: When a desktop app owns the agent processes, closing it stops the work. When several clients reach the same agent, any of them can send, pause, or resend, and nothing records who decided what. BAT Cowork keeps BAT's interface, drops its local sidecar and agent spawning, and lets a Paseo daemon own agents, worktrees, and task state, with the task rules next to the sessions they guard.
body.zh: 如果 agent 程序綁在桌面 app 上，關掉 app，工作就停了。好幾個客戶端連到同一個 agent 時，誰都能送指令、暫停或重送，也沒有地方記錄是誰決定了什麼。BAT Cowork 保留 BAT 的介面，拿掉它在本機的 sidecar 與啟動 agent 的部分，改由 Paseo daemon 管理 agent、worktree 與任務狀態，任務規則就放在它要把關的 session 旁邊。

quote.en: Viewers can comment. Only the driver gives instructions.
quote.zh: 旁觀者可以留言，主導者才能下指令。

title.en: What is in the tree today, tested only locally.
title.zh: 目前做好的部分，都只在本機測過。

intro.en: Everything below ran against a local test daemon with an in-process fake Claude client. None of it has driven a real agent yet.
intro.zh: 以下每一項都只在本機測試 daemon 上、搭配程序內的假 Claude 客戶端跑過，還沒有驅動過真正的 agent。

title.zh: 沿用 BAT 介面，保留授權聲明

body.en: The renderer is imported from Better Agent Terminal at 41ea2b1 under MIT, with TonyQ's copyright notice kept. A new Tauri crate uses its own app id, dev.teddashh.bat-cowork, with no updater and no BAT update endpoint.
body.zh: 介面程式碼從 Better Agent Terminal 的 41ea2b1 匯入，採 MIT 授權並保留 TonyQ 的版權聲明。新的 Tauri crate 使用自己的 app id（dev.teddashh.bat-cowork），沒有自動更新，也不連 BAT 的更新端點。

title.en: A read-only view of a daemon

body.en: The browser shell takes the daemon's WebSocket address as a query parameter and reads workspaces, files, diff, branch, and commit history. The read port has no create or send method, and PTY writes throw.
body.zh: 瀏覽器版用網址參數指定 daemon 的 WebSocket 位址，讀取工作區、檔案、diff、分支與 commit 紀錄。讀取埠沒有建立或送出的方法，PTY 寫入一律丟出錯誤。

body.en: Only the driver can instruct, pause, cancel, or release a paused task. Viewers can comment and propose. The daemon stamps each event with the connection's client id, and a takeover holds sends until the current writer settles.
body.zh: 只有主導者能下指令、暫停、取消，或讓暫停的任務繼續；旁觀者可以留言與提案。daemon 會在每個事件蓋上該連線的 client id；有人接手時，會先暫停送出，等目前的寫入者收尾。

body.en: Sends to a managed agent go through authorizeCoworkWrite. A stale revision, an old epoch, a paused task, the wrong writer, or a repeated message id is refused. Unmanaged agents keep the stock Paseo path.
body.zh: 送給受管 agent 的訊息都要先通過 authorizeCoworkWrite。revision 過時、epoch 舊了、任務暫停中、寫入者不對，或 message id 重複，一律拒絕。未受管的 agent 照走 Paseo 原本的路徑。

title.zh: 重啟後還在的任務帳本

body.en: Tasks are written to {paseoHome}/cowork/tasks.json and restored when the daemon starts. A paused task stays held. A command that was in flight becomes unknown until the driver acknowledges it, and it is not resent.
body.zh: 任務寫在 {paseoHome}/cowork/tasks.json，daemon 啟動時還原。暫停中的任務維持暫停；重啟前還在執行的指令會標成 unknown，要等主導者確認，而且不會重送。

title.zh: 有新 commit 才算完成

body.en: When a managed turn ends, the task is verified only if HEAD moved past the last verified commit and the tree is clean. Each failed check counts a rework attempt, and after two the task becomes a blocker. No test result feeds this yet.
body.zh: 受管的回合結束時，只有 HEAD 越過上一個已驗證的 commit、而且工作目錄是乾淨的，任務才算 verified。每次檢查沒過就記一次重做，滿兩次後任務就標成卡關。目前還沒有接上測試結果。

title.en: BAT on the outside, Paseo underneath.
title.zh: 外面是 BAT，底下是 Paseo。

intro.en: The desktop is a client. The daemon owns agents, worktrees, and task state, and the cowork rules run inside it. Paseo's server, client, protocol, and CLI stay on their upstream paths, and the cowork code is wired in through seven upstream files: 237 lines added, one removed.
intro.zh: 桌面端只是客戶端。agent、worktree 與任務狀態都歸 daemon 管，協作規則也在 daemon 裡執行。Paseo 的 server、client、協定與 CLI 都留在上游原本的路徑，協作程式碼只透過七個上游檔案接進來：新增 237 行，刪除 1 行。

lines.en: Tauri shell does not compile yet
Tests use a fake Claude client
lines.zh: 測試用假的 Claude 客戶端
由 daemon 建立的 worktree

items.en: Not an official Paseo or BAT build, and not a release
items.zh: 不是 Paseo 或 BAT 的官方版本，也不是正式發行版

items.en: No signing key, no updater, no staging host
items.zh: 沒有簽章金鑰、沒有自動更新，也不連 staging 主機

items.en: BAT host calls that are not ported throw instead of half working
items.zh: 還沒移植的 BAT 主機功能直接丟出錯誤，不做半套

items.en: No provider dispatch until a real CLI contract test passes
items.zh: 真正的 CLI 合約測試通過之前，不派工給任何供應者

items.en: Cutover stays closed while any package is not accepted
items.zh: 只要還有工作包沒通過，就不切換上線

title.en: Why it is built this way.
Fork the daemon, keep its paths

body.en: Paseo's server, client, protocol, and CLI stay where upstream keeps them, and the cowork code lives in new folders, so upstream changes stay easy to compare. The cost: the rules hook into Paseo's Session handler instead of owning the flow.
body.zh: Paseo 的 server、client、協定與 CLI 都留在上游原本的位置，協作程式碼放在新的資料夾，和上游比對差異比較容易。代價是協作規則得掛在 Paseo 的 Session 處理流程上，而不是自己掌控整個流程。

title.en: Rules in the daemon, not a second service
title.zh: 規則放在 daemon 裡，不另開服務

body.en: Task rules run in the same process as the sessions they guard. bat-agent-connector's Python task daemon is a behavior reference only and is not vendored, so there is one owner of task state and no second ledger to reconcile.
body.zh: 任務規則和它要把關的 session 跑在同一個程序裡。bat-agent-connector 的 Python 任務服務只當行為參考，沒有複製進來，所以任務狀態只有一個擁有者，不會有第二本帳要對。

body.en: BAT host calls that are not ported throw UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY, every provider is marked not admitted, and ungated ingress throws. The UI shows less, but nothing quietly half works.
body.zh: 還沒移植的 BAT 主機呼叫一律丟出 UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY，每個供應者都標成未獲准，沒有關卡的入口也直接丟錯。介面能顯示的東西變少，但不會有功能悄悄只做一半。

title.en: The gate is a file a test reads
title.zh: 發行關卡是一個由測試把關的檔案

body.en: RELEASE-GATE.md is plain text. w6-release-gate.test.ts fails if it stops saying Not a release, if cutover opens, or if any package other than W0 is marked accepted, so changing the status means changing a test too.
body.zh: RELEASE-GATE.md 是純文字檔。只要它不再寫著 Not a release、切換被打開，或 W0 以外的工作包被標成 accepted，w6-release-gate.test.ts 就會失敗，所以要改狀態，也得一起改測試。

title.en: Read the gate, then run the tests.

intro.en: There is nothing to install as a product. In a clone of the repo, these suites need only Node (24 was used here) and no npm install. The server-side cowork tests run under vitest and need the full Paseo workspace install.
intro.zh: 目前沒有可以安裝的產品。在 clone 下來的 repo 裡，下面這幾組測試只需要 Node（這裡用的是 24 版），不用 npm install。server 端的協作測試跑在 vitest 上，需要先安裝整個 Paseo workspace。

body.en: The reducer, dispatch policy, ingress table, and UI parity rows.
body.zh: 涵蓋 reducer、派工規則、ingress 對照表與介面對等清單。

title.zh: 唯讀客戶端邊界：7 個測試

body.en: From the repo root. Checks that writes are not reachable and auth headers stay in one module.
body.zh: 從 repo 根目錄執行。確認寫入方法拿不到，驗證標頭也只在一個模組裡處理。

title.zh: 桌面主機的拒絕行為：5 個測試

body.en: From the repo root. Unported BAT calls must throw, and reads must go through the daemon port.
body.zh: 從 repo 根目錄執行。還沒移植的 BAT 呼叫必須丟出錯誤，讀取也必須經過 daemon 的讀取埠。

intro.en: Work began on 2026-09-30, and the tree is still changing quickly. There are no tags or releases, and the Paseo CI workflows that came with the tree fail here. Paseo is by Mohamed Boudra and contributors; BAT is by TonyQ. This is not an official build of either.
intro.zh: 2026 年 9 月 30 日才開始，程式碼還在快速變動。沒有任何 tag 或正式版本，跟著原始碼一起來的 Paseo CI 流程在這裡也是失敗的。Paseo 的作者是 Mohamed Boudra 與其貢獻者，BAT 的作者是 TonyQ；本專案不是兩者的官方版本。

works_title.en: Works on a local test daemon
works_title.zh: 在本機測試 daemon 上可用

works.en: W0 accepted: the Paseo snapshot at 53ee9cd, upstream-lock.json, third-party notices, and the inventories in cowork-core
works.zh: W0 已通過：Paseo 53ee9cd 快照、upstream-lock.json、第三方聲明，以及 cowork-core 裡的各項清單

works.en: Two clients see one run; a repeated message id does not start a second turn; a daemon-made worktree receives the commit
works.zh: 兩個客戶端看到同一次執行；重複的 message id 不會開第二輪；commit 落在 daemon 建立的 worktree

works.en: Pause, takeover, rework, and restart paths in the task reducer, with a journal that survives a daemon restart
works.zh: 任務 reducer 的暫停、接手、重做與重啟流程，帳本在 daemon 重啟後仍在

works.en: A browser shell that reads workspaces, files, diff, and commit history from a local daemon
works.zh: 瀏覽器版可以從本機 daemon 讀取工作區、檔案、diff 與 commit 紀錄

works.en: 29 tests that need no install pass in a local run: 17 task core, 7 client boundary, 5 desktop host
works.zh: 不需安裝的 29 個測試在本機全數通過：任務核心 17 個、客戶端邊界 7 個、桌面主機 5 個

limits_title.en: Not done, and not safe yet

limits.en: Not a release: no tags, no signing key, no updater. Do not point it at a production daemon or an existing BAT session
limits.zh: 不是正式版本：沒有 tag、沒有簽章金鑰、沒有自動更新。不要把它接到正式環境的 daemon 或既有的 BAT session

limits.en: The Tauri shell has not been built: the one compile attempt stopped in glib-sys because pkg-config was missing, so there is no desktop window yet
limits.zh: Tauri 版還沒建置成功：唯一一次編譯在 glib-sys 就失敗了（環境裡沒有 pkg-config），所以還沒有桌面視窗

limits.en: No agent provider is admitted: Claude, Codex, and Grok stay closed, and every turn in the tests comes from a fake Claude client
limits.zh: 沒有任何 agent 供應者獲准：Claude、Codex、Grok 都還關著，測試裡的每一輪都來自假的 Claude 客戶端

limits.en: Only 2 of Paseo's 90 inbound write messages pass the cowork gate; the other 88 are not wired
limits.zh: Paseo 的 90 種寫入訊息裡，只有 2 種經過協作關卡，其餘 88 種還沒接上

limits.en: No client message opens a task or sends an instruction yet, the terminal is refused, and the journal is one JSON file rewritten on every event
limits.zh: 還沒有客戶端訊息能開任務或下指令，終端機也被拒絕；帳本只是一個每次事件都整份重寫的 JSON 檔

limits.en: Workspace scope is an upstream gap: Paseo grants are daemon-wide, and file preview accepts any file the daemon can read
limits.zh: 工作區範圍是上游的缺口：Paseo 的授權是整個 daemon 層級，檔案預覽也接受 daemon 讀得到的任何檔案
